description: Source code for a parser and writer for a custom serialization format used in the Wesnoth game, including class definitions, parsing logic, and serialization functions.

classes.name: parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing a custom serialization format from an input stream into a config object.

methods.name: parser::operator()
methods.description: Main parsing function that processes the input stream and populates the config object.

methods.name: parser::parse_element
methods.description: Parses an element (tag) in the serialization format.

methods.name: parser::parse_variable
methods.description: Parses a variable assignment in the serialization format.

methods.name: parser::lineno_string
methods.description: Generates an error message string with line and file info.

methods.name: parser::error
methods.description: Handles parsing errors by throwing exceptions with detailed messages.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and parses data from an input stream into a config object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes a config object to an output stream in the custom format.
